referents.why: 'his hand' is third masculine singular; the one who stretches out the hand is Aaron, named in the clause.
'his staff' is third masculine singular, Aaron's staff.
'they did so' is a plural report of the command chain, which was addressed to Moses (to tell) and Aaron (to act); a plural can refer only to the two together, so the composite Moses and Aaron.
'he struck' continues the subject named in the preceding clause, Aaron.
